doc: One plot of a plan for the game to fill (design/planner.md, Plots): a building's lot, a road segment, a waterfront's lot, or a body of water.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Stable within the plan.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What fills it: a building (a house, a civic building, a castle part, a centre), a road segment (road, a cell at a time), a waterfront building, or water.

fields.name: tier
fields.doc: When it opens.

fields.name: size_class
fields.doc: A building's or waterfront's size class (a castle part's, a centre's).

fields.name: shape
fields.doc: A building's lot shape.

fields.name: lot
fields.doc: Which of the config's lots it is (buildings and waterfronts).

fields.name: anchor_q
fields.doc: The cell a building's origin stands on (a road or water plot: its first cell): axial q.

fields.name: anchor_r
fields.doc: Axial r.

fields.name: turn
fields.doc: Sixths of a turn about +y: a building's +z faces its road; a waterfront's faces the water.

fields.name: pad
fields.doc: Its level ground height, metres (a road or water plot: its first cell's).

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Where a building's origin goes, metres.

fields.name: yaw_deg
fields.doc: The building's turn, degrees from +z toward +x.

fields.name: use
fields.doc: The zoning's first choice (a road's way, a water body's water; a castle part's castle; a square's centre; a crop field's field).

fields.name: road
fields.doc: A road segment's class.

fields.name: wealth
fields.doc: 0 to 1, by the scenario's gradient.

fields.name: frontage
fields.doc: How many road cells its front (a waterfront: its back) touches.

fields.name: walk_m
fields.doc: The walk from the nearest entrance to its frontage, metres.

fields.name: reached
fields.doc: Reached from every entrance open at its tier.

fields.name: cart
fields.doc: Reached by a cart from at least one entrance.

fields.name: drop
fields.doc: A waterfront's: how far below its pad the water lies, metres.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: Its cells, as q, r pairs.

fields.name: heights
fields.doc: Each cell's height, metres (a road segment's cells differ; a building's are its pad).

fields.name: edges
fields.doc: Per cell (in cells' order), what each of its six neighbours is, 3 bits per edge in the hex directions' order (axial (1,0), (1,-1), (0,-1), (-1,0), (-1,1), (0,1)): 0 road, 1 a building's front, 2 open, 3 water, 4 wall, 5 gate, 6 a waterfront, 7 a building's side or back. road's mask.

fields.name: roles
fields.doc: Per cell, a road's role: 0 a path, 1 a bridge (road's role).

fields.name: halves
fields.doc: Per cell, a road's half (road's half): 0 to 5, or 6 for none. 0 to 5, the half holding edges h and h + 1 whole (cut through the middles of edges h + 2 and h + 5), or 6 for none. It never takes an edge the cell's flow uses, so the other half keeps every way through open.

fields.name: flows
fields.doc: Per cell, which edges a walker or cart passes through: bit d for edge d.

fields.name: fences
fields.doc: Per cell, which edges carry a fence (bit d for edge d): a fence line runs along them.

fields.name: doors
fields.doc: Per road cell, which edges face a plot's door (bit d for edge d): a strict way, kept clear.
